headline.en: Private credit defaults climb to 6.3% in August, Fitch says
headline.zh: Fitch称8月私人信贷违约率攀升至6.3%

summary.en: Fitch reported that private credit defaults rose to 6.3% in August. No further details were provided.
summary.zh: Fitch报告称，8月私人信贷违约率升至6.3%。未提供更多细节。

headline.en: U.S. Private Credit Default Rate Climbs to Record 6.3%; Software Sector Defies Trend, Falling to 0.6%
headline.zh: 美国私人信贷违约率攀升至创纪录的6.3%；软件行业逆势下降至0.6%

summary.en: The U.S. private credit default rate climbed to a record 6.3%, according to the report. The software sector defied the trend, with its default rate falling to 0.6%.
summary.zh: 报告称，美国私人信贷违约率攀升至创纪录的6.3%。软件行业逆势而行，其违约率下降至0.6%。

headline.en: Bally's Lands $560M Loan From WhiteHawk for Bronx Casino Development
headline.zh: Bally's 从 WhiteHawk 获得5.6亿美元贷款，用于布朗克斯赌场开发

summary.en: Bally's announced it secured a $560 million debt package from private credit investment manager WhiteHawk Capital Partners to fund its casino development in the Bronx. The financing consists of a $400 million frontloaded loan and $160 million in delayed-draw term debt.
summary.zh: Bally's 宣布从私人信贷投资管理公司 WhiteHawk Capital Partners 获得5.6亿美元债务融资，用于资助其在布朗克斯的赌场开发项目。该融资包括4亿美元的前端贷款和1.6亿美元的延迟提取定期债务。

source.publisher: Commercial Real Estate Financing | Commercial Observer

headline.en: AB CarVal Acquires $340 Million Multifamily and Build-to-Rent Construction Loan Portfolio
headline.zh: AB CarVal 收购 3.4 亿美元多户住宅及建租住宅建设贷款组合

summary.en: AB CarVal acquired a $340 million multifamily and build-to-rent construction loan portfolio. No further details on seller, pricing or terms were disclosed.
summary.zh: AB CarVal 收购了一个价值 3.4 亿美元的多户住宅及建租住宅（build-to-rent）建设贷款组合。卖方、定价或条款等进一步细节未披露。

headline.en: US private debt default rate hits record high in August: Fitch Ratings
headline.zh: 惠誉评级：8月美国私人债务违约率创历史新高

summary.en: Fitch Ratings reported that the US private debt default rate reached a record high in August, according to Crypto Briefing.
summary.zh: 据 Crypto Briefing 报道，惠誉评级（Fitch Ratings）称8月美国私人债务违约率创下历史新高。

headline.en: U.S. private credit defaults rise: Fitch
headline.zh: Fitch：美国私募信贷违约上升

summary.en: Fitch reported that U.S. private credit defaults have risen. No further figures, managers or details were provided in the article.
summary.zh: Fitch报告称美国私募信贷违约上升。文章未提供更多数据、管理人或其他细节。
